slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The essay's Libya registry row states that the Civil Registration Authority's branches, issuing offices and service offices, rural ones included, are all fully automated and electronically linked through a single database since at least 2020, citing the health ministry's 2020 vital statistics report.

The essay states that all of the Civil Registration Authority's 12 branches, 133 issuing offices and 400 service offices are fully automated and electronically linked, as at 2020, citing the health ministry's 2020 vital statistics report; it gives no count of offices entering events.

The essay states that the automated, linked offices yield timely data with 100 per cent of births and more than 90 per cent of deaths registered, as at 2020, citing the health ministry's 2020 vital statistics report.
